items.summary: Ensure InputGesture dialog is accessible even if new gesture was not added (#21058)
items.fullMessage:
Ensure InputGesture dialog is accessible even if new gesture was not added (#21058)

Fixes #20980
Summary of the issue:

If the InputGesturesDialog is entered and Add is clicked but no new input gesture added, this leaves the InputGesturesDialog inaccessible.
Description of user facing changes:

User can now see the InputGesturesDialog, even if the previous invocation of the dialog didn't add a new gesture properly
Description of developer facing changes:

Check for whether the InputGesturesDialog still has a CaptureFunc installed during teardown, and clear if so.

    A new variable is created to store the last installed CaptureFunc in InputGesturesDialog, in order to compare against inputCore.manager._captureFunc when the dialog is destroyed
    A new function _setCaptureFunc is created to encapsulate storing a new capture func both in InputGesturesDialog and also in inputCore.manager

Description of development approach:

Alternatives were considered to the approach in the PR

    Don't store the last captureFunc within InputGesturesDialog. Instead try to determine if inputCore.manager._captureFunc matches a lambda generated from a function within InputGesturesDialog. Rejected because the logic to do this check is very heuristic and hard to follow
    Replace lambda functions with wrapper functions, for use a captureFunc. This means the check on the function is easier. Rejected because because it is a larger change
    Avoid the check altogether - The dialog isn't modal, and it looks like other dialogs e.g. the help dialog can be invoked while the InputGesturesDialog is active. Rejected because it could potentially introduce subtle bugs.
